effects.does: Opens Clara to help generate an RFP.
effects.affects: Uses the event's line items as input for AI-generated RFP questions.
effects.check: Click Ask Clara and verify that the Clara interface opens when line items exist.

effects.does: Opens the attachment control so files can be added to the event.
effects.affects: Adds attachment data to the event.
effects.check: Click Add Attachments and verify that a file-selection interface opens.

effects.does: Opens the control for adding terms and conditions.
effects.affects: Adds or changes the event's terms-and-conditions data.
effects.leadsTo: Terms and Conditions drawer or dialog.
effects.check: Click Add T&Cs and verify that the terms editor opens.

effects.does: Opens the event's two line items for review or editing.
effects.affects: Changes the event's line-item records when items are edited or deleted.
effects.check: Click Items 2 and verify that two event items are displayed.

effects.does: Saves the current event as a draft.
effects.affects: Creates or updates the draft event group and its line items.
effects.leadsTo: The saved draft state or the current screen with draft data persisted.
effects.check: Click Save as draft and verify that a draft event is created or updated.

effects.does: Starts publishing the event using the applicable publish action.
effects.affects: Moves the event toward publication and persists its stages and participants.
effects.leadsTo: Publish confirmation dialog or the resulting published event state.
effects.check: Click Publish and verify that the expected confirmation or validation response appears.

effects.does: Selects RFQ as the event mode.
effects.affects: Changes the event mode and may reset data when switching from another mode.
effects.leadsTo: The RFQ event configuration on this screen.
effects.check: Select RFQ and verify that RFQ-specific configuration is shown.

effects.does: Opens template selection for a buying template.
effects.affects: Sets or changes the event template and its configured fields.
effects.check: Click Buy Template and verify that available templates are displayed.

effects.does: Opens the control for adding event table columns.
effects.affects: Changes the columns shown for the event's item or bid data.
effects.check: Click Add Columns and verify that selectable columns are displayed.

effects.does: Opens the event Details view.
effects.affects: Nothing to the event data.
effects.check: Click Details and verify that event detail information is displayed.

effects.does: Opens the Price Components view.
effects.affects: Changes price-component configuration if values are edited.
effects.check: Click Price Components and verify that price-component fields are displayed.

effects.does: Opens vendor selection so vendors can be invited.
effects.affects: Adds selected vendor company UUIDs to the event audience.
effects.check: Click Invite Vendor, select a vendor, and verify that the vendor appears among invitees.

effects.does: Opens the event participant list.
effects.affects: Changes participant records if participants are added or removed.
effects.check: Click Participants and verify that the event participants are listed.

effects.does: Opens the event savings configuration or summary.
effects.affects: Changes or displays savings data for the event.
effects.check: Click Savings and verify that savings fields or values are shown.

effects.does: Opens the event's terms and conditions.
effects.affects: Changes the terms-and-conditions data applied to the event.
effects.leadsTo: Terms and Conditions drawer or panel.
effects.check: Click Terms & Conditions and verify that the configured terms are displayed.

effects.does: Opens the schedule control showing a start of now and a 30-minute duration.
effects.affects: Changes the event stage start time, end time, or duration when edited.
effects.check: Click the schedule chip and verify that start and duration controls open.

effects.does: Leaves the schedule editor without saving the schedule changes.
effects.affects: Discards unsaved schedule data.
effects.check: Change a schedule value, click Back, and verify that the change is not persisted.

effects.does: Saves the configured schedule.
effects.affects: Stores the schedule configuration on the current stage and applies recurring configuration to each stage when applicable.
effects.leadsTo: The previous event-creation screen or saved schedule state.
effects.check: Set a schedule, click Save Schedule, and verify that the schedule is retained after reopening it.

effects.does: Selects the Technical Stage tab.
effects.affects: Nothing to the event data.
effects.check: Click Technical Stage and verify that its stage content is displayed.

effects.does: Selects or keeps the RFQ stage tab active.
effects.affects: Nothing to the event data.
effects.check: Click RFQ and verify that RFQ controls and fields are displayed.

effects.does: Navigates back to the Events area.
effects.affects: Nothing to the event data.
effects.check: Click Events and verify that the Events page opens.

effects.control: Enter the title of the project
effects.does: Sets the project title.
effects.affects: Updates the event group's title used when the draft or event is saved.
effects.check: Enter a title, save the event, and verify that the saved event shows that title.

effects.does: Remains unavailable for date entry while the event is configured to start now.
effects.affects: Does not change the schedule while disabled.
effects.check: Verify that Select date cannot receive input when Start now is selected.

effects.does: Sets the event start time.
effects.affects: Updates the stage start time used to calculate the event schedule.
effects.check: Select a time and verify that the chosen start time appears in the field.

effects.control: Search vendors you want to add
effects.does: Searches for and selects vendors to invite.
effects.affects: Updates the event audience vendor records.
effects.leadsTo: Stays here with selected vendors shown.
effects.check: Search for a vendor, select it, and verify that it appears as an invited vendor.

effects.does: Sets the event to start immediately.
effects.affects: Sets the stage start mode to now and makes the end time relative to the current time.
effects.check: Select Start now and verify that the schedule displays a Now start.

effects.does: Sets the event duration or opens duration choices.
effects.affects: Updates the calculated event end time.
effects.leadsTo: Stays here with the selected duration.
effects.check: Choose a duration and verify that the schedule chip shows the corresponding duration and end time.

effects.does: Turns recurring scheduling on or off.
effects.affects: Adds or removes the recurring schedule configuration for the event stages.
effects.leadsTo: Stays here with recurring-schedule options shown when enabled.
effects.check: Turn the switch on and verify that recurring schedule settings appear.

effects.does: Displays or edits the required Product column for a line item.
effects.affects: Changes the line item's product UUID when editing is allowed.
effects.leadsTo: Stays here or opens product selection.
effects.check: Verify that every line item has a Product value and that product selection works when enabled.

effects.does: Displays or edits the required Product Variant column for a line item.
effects.affects: Changes the line item's product-quality or variant UUID when editing is allowed.
effects.leadsTo: Stays here or opens product-variant selection.
effects.check: Verify that every line item has a Product Variant value and that variant selection works when enabled.

effects.does: Entering a value sets the requested quantity for the line item.
effects.affects: Updates the line item's quantity in the event data and determines the quantity vendors are asked to quote.
effects.check: Enter a valid quantity and verify that the line item retains it and the required-field error is cleared.

effects.does: Entering or selecting a value sets the delivery location for the line item.
effects.affects: Updates the delivery-location data used for the event's fulfillment details.
effects.check: Provide a delivery location and verify that the required-field error is cleared and the value remains visible.

effects.does: Entering a value sets the line item's price.
effects.affects: Updates the price basis used for the event and its amount calculations.
effects.check: Enter a valid price and verify that it is displayed with the selected currency and the required-field error is cleared.

effects.does: Entering a value sets the quantity available for the line item.
effects.affects: Updates the available-quantity data that can constrain the quantity offered or fulfilled.
effects.check: Enter a valid available quantity and verify that the value is retained without a required-field error.

effects.does: Entering a value sets the GST for the line item.
effects.affects: Updates the tax data used when calculating the line item's total amount.
effects.check: Enter a GST value and verify that it is retained and reflected in the displayed amount if the amount is recalculated.

effects.does: Displays or updates the calculated total amount for the line item.
effects.affects: Changes the monetary total recorded or shown for the line item based on its pricing and tax inputs.
effects.check: Change the price, quantity, or GST and verify that the total amount updates consistently.

cases.title: Publish confirmation shows the scheduled event summary
steps: Review the event summary in the confirmation dialog.
cases.expected: The summary shows "Starts on: Now", an ending time with the duration, and "Vendors invited:" with the de-duplicated vendor count. The displayed timing matches the event schedule.
cases.setup: Use the displayed start chip. Add two vendors, including the same vendor twice if the vendor selector permits it. Complete the required line-item values.
gaps: The catalog cannot prove that the displayed vendor count is de-duplicated from duplicate vendor invitations.
The catalog cannot compare the displayed dynamic ending time directly against the schedule configuration; it can only check visible summary text and the configured duration.

cases.title: Custom duration requires an end time before publishing
cases.expected: "Save Schedule" accepts the schedule, but publishing is refused with exactly "Please add end time for the event".
cases.setup: Open the schedule settings. Use "Duration" to choose Custom duration. Do not enter an end time.

cases.title: Back discards unsaved schedule changes
steps: Reopen the schedule screen without saving.
cases.expected: The changed time is not retained. The schedule returns to its previously saved values.
cases.setup: Open an existing unsaved schedule state and note the current value in "Select time".
gaps: Directly select the schedule control labeled "Select time" and verify the exact changed time because no dedicated schedule-time selection step is available.
Directly assert the schedule's previously saved time value; the plan compares the captured Start time display instead.

cases.title: Recurring configuration is copied to every stage
steps: Turn on "Mark as Recurring EventSet this event to repeat automaticall".
cases.expected: The RFQ stage has the same recurring configuration as the Technical Stage, including the recurrence type, interval, and ending settings.
cases.setup: Use a project containing both the Technical Stage and RFQ stages.

cases.title: Select date remains unavailable for a Now start
steps: Change "Start now" to a scheduled start option.
cases.expected: "Select date" is disabled while "Start now" is selected. After choosing a scheduled start option, the date and time controls become available for entry.
cases.setup: Open the schedule screen with "Start now" selected.
